skygo --json jobs retention
domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json hold
controller start
barrier start arm
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id active
json-value id JOB
barrier start await
await-state $JOB starting
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *0'
stdout 'operation_pending'
assert-native 0
assert-output 0
barrier start release
await-state $JOB running
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *0'
stdout 'active'
# Log-only cannot expire the active current output domain either.
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --logs-only --yes
stdout '"marked": *0'
stdout 'current_output'
cp released.txt release
await-state $JOB succeeded
assert-native 0
assert-output 0

-- released.txt --
released
